verses.text: Ex ix ayxo eyetb'eyum, yowalil tze k'anab'ajej heb' winh eyetb'eyum chi', yik tato ayex mach ex max yak'och sk'o'ol heb' winh eyetb'eyum chi' t'a slolonel Dios, manh yowalilok ay tas tzeyal t'a heb' winh, palta ol montajoch heb' winh yuj he b'eyb'al chi',
yujto ol yil heb' winh to munil ayex, tzex xiwpax t'a Dios.

Ayokab' he wach'il, manhoklaj chajtil yilji he niwanil swala'. Manh eyak'och he pensar t'a chajtil tzeyutej he ch'uman xil he jolom. Manh eyak'och he pensar t'a juntzanh k'e'en oro yet' juntzanh pichul caro stojol tzeyak'ochi. Manhok yet' juntzanh chi' tze b'o he b'a.

Palta aokab' he k'olb'al tzeyak' eyip he b'o'ani, yik wach' eyilji t'a sat Dios. Ha he wach'il chi', malaj b'ak'inh ol lajwok. Tato nanam tzeyutej he pensar, emnakil pax tzeyutej he b'a, wach' yilji jun chi' t'a sat Dios, niwan yelk'och t'a yichanh.
Ha t'a peka', ay juntzanh heb' ix ix icha chi' yutejnak sb'eyb'al, yak'nakoch spensar heb' ix t'a Dios. Sk'anab'ajannak pax heb' winh yetb'eyum heb' ix.

Icha chi' yutejnak sb'a ix Sara. Sk'anab'ajejnak wal ix tas syal winhaj Abraham. Yalnak pax ix icha tik t'a winh “wajal ach”, xchi ix. Ha exxo tik, ex ix, wach' tzeyutej he b'eyb'al. Mokab' ex och ilk'olal he naub'tanhan tas xiwub'tak ol jawok, tato icha chi' lajan he pensar yet' ix Sara chi'.

Ha exxo winak ex ayxo heb' ix eyetb'eyum, wach' tzeyutej he pensar t'a heb' ix. Nachajokab'el eyu'uj to lajan heb' ix icha junok lum chen k'un spoji. Ayokab' yelk'och heb' ix t'a he sat, yujto junnhej he k 'inal ix he cha yet' heb' ix yuj swach'k'olal Dios. Icha chi' tzeyutej he b'a t'a heb' ix, yik ol ab'chaj he lesal yet' heb' ix.

Hanhejtona', swalan junxo tik t'ayex. Junxonhej tzeyutej he pensar he masanil. Tato ay heb' skusi, kolwajanhek yet' heb'. Slaj he xajanej he b'a, yujto eyuk'tak eyanab' he b'a. Tzeyil-laj he k'o'ol t'ayex junjun ex. Nanam tzeyutej he b'a junjun ex.

Tato ay heb' chuk syutej sb'a t'ayex, manh chukok tzeyutej pax he b'a t'a heb'. Tato ay heb' tzex b'uchani, manh he b'uch pax heb', palta a swach'k'olal Dios tze k'an t'a yib'anh heb', yujto ix onh yawtejoch Dios yikok, yik syak' swach'k'olal t'ayonh.
Yujto icha tik syal t'a Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkani: Tato syal he k'o'ol snajatb'i he k 'inal, he gana pax tzalajk'olal tzek' junjun k'u eyu'uj, manhxo eyal chukal lolonel, manhxo eyesej.
Ik'ekel he b'a t'a chukal, haxo wach'il tze k'ulej, manhxo eyak' owal, a junk'olal tze b'eyb'alejnhej.
Yujto ha Dios Kajal stanhwan heb' anima wach' sb'eyb'al, smaklan wal yab'i ayik syalan sb'a heb' t'ay, palta aykot yowal sk'o'ol t'a heb' sk'ulan chukal, xchikani.
Tato anhej wach'il sko k'ulej, ¿mach junok ol ik'ancha'anh chukal t'a ko patik?
Palta tato yujnhej ko wach' b'eyb'al skab' sya'il, te wach' kiko'. Yujto tz'ib'yajkani: Manh eyek xiw he b'a he na'an yuj tas ijan tzex yutej heb'. Manh he cha somchajel he pensar, xchikani.

Ko naokab'i to a Cristo ayoch Yajalil t'ayonh, Axonhejochi. Listaokab' skutej ko b'a kalan yab' heb' sk'anb'an t'ayonh tas yuj skak'och Cristo chi' yipok ko k'o'ol. Emnakilokab' skutej kalan t'a heb', k'ununiokab' skutej kalani,

yujto ayoch ko pensar t'a Cristo chi'. Wach' skutej ko b'eyb'al yik wach' malaj tas syal jun tz'ak'an kojtakejeli tas wach' yet' tas chuk, yik wach' a heb' tzonh b'uchan yuj ko wach' b'eyb'al yujto creyente onh, ol k'ixwok heb'.
Te wach' tato skab' sya'il yuj ko wach' b'eyb'al, tato icha chi' tz'el t'a sk'o'ol Dios, t'a yichanh to yuj ko chuk b'eyb'al skab' sya'il.

Yujto a Cristo ix ab'an sya'il. Ix cham yuj ko mul junel. Te tojol spensar. Ha onhxo tik, manh tojolok ko pensar, palta A' ix yab' sya'il ku'uj, yik tzonh yik'b'at t'a Dios. Ha sniwanil ix chami, palta haxo yik ix pitzwixi, a Espíritu ix ak'anxi pitzwok.
Yuj Espíritu chi', ix xit'ek' yalel slolonel Dios t'a juntzanh pixan preso yajkani,

haton t'a spixanil heb' manh k'anab'ajannakok Dios t'a peka' t'a stiempoal winhaj Noé. Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', niwan yutejnak sk'o'ol Dios t'a heb', yik stanhwej sb'o jun niwan barco. Ha yuj te' barco chi' ay jaywanh heb' kolchajnak el t'a ha ha'. Wajxakwanh heb' kolchajnakkaneli.

Ha jun tas ujinak chi', ch'oxnab'il yaji, yujto yuj ha ha' yet' bautismo tzonh kolchaj tiknaik yujto ix pitzwixi Jesucristo. Ha jun bautismo tik, manh yopisio'ok yik'anel smikal ko niwanil, palta a sch'oxani, to manh chab'k'olalok ix kak' ko ti' t'a Dios.
Paxnakk'e Jesucristo chi' t'a satcha'anh. Ha t'a swach' k'ab' Dios ayek' tiknaik. Ha tz'ak'an mandar masanil heb' ángel, masanil juntzanhxo ay yopisio manh chekelok yet' heb' ay spoder.
